  ↳ At this chunk's round-close, a Bash command chained safe_write appends with an invariants.py grep whose output included 'OK   [critical] creators_log_append_only: append-only intact — 270 committed…'. post_write_verify's OK-line regex (^OK\s+(.+?)\s+—) matched that invariant line and captured '[critical] creators_log_append_only: append-only intact' as a repo path, which .exists()==False -> exit 2 'vanished after write' (false corruption block). VERIFIED no real corruption: creators_log verify = 271 entries 0 problems; git diff log.jsonl = pure append +1/-0; build-log tail correct. FIX (systemic, per doctrine — fix the guard not the symptom): tightened regex to ^OK\s+(?!\[)(\S.*?)\s+— so invariant severity lines (which start with '[') are skipped. Tested: T1 (safe_write line + the offending invariant line) -> exit 0 no flag; T2 (safe_write OK for a nonexistent path) -> exit 2 still catches real vanish. No memory needed — the guard now handles it.
